title: installer: subagent is trusted verb by verb, and subagent_spawn asks
why: Operator decision (2026-10-07, 'Ask on spawn'): in auto mode every subagent spawn asks, and the ask shows the spawn's input (yolo:true included) so the person sees when a child would run in yolo. Today trust_one's "jev" | "subagent" arm runs a bare `plugins trust subagent`, which vouches subagent_spawn too. The other verbs act only on children that a spawn the person approved already made, so they stay vouched. yolo mode is unchanged (every ask is a yes). SA1/SA2 (merged and in flight) make a child run under the parent's config; this slice is the ask.
what:
installer/src/plugins.rs:
- A const SUBAGENT_VOUCHED = ["list", "trace", "steer", "cancel", "pick", "plan"] beside TERM_VOUCHED (the subagent manifest's tools are spawn, list, trace, steer, cancel, pick, plan: eidolon-plugins/subagent/plugin.rn).
- trust_one gets a "subagent" arm shaped like "term": untrust_all("subagent") first, then `plugins trust subagent <verb>` for each of SUBAGENT_VOUCHED, and the line 'subagent: trusted list, trace, steer, cancel, pick and plan; subagent_spawn is not vouched and asks'. "jev" keeps its bare trust (its own arm).
- No grant changes (subagent has no token).
- The comment above the arms says why spawn is left out.
owns_files: plugins/README.md (only if it lists what each plugin is trusted for)
tests:
- no_plugin_name_makes_a_vouch_for_term_send (or a new sibling test): no bare `plugins trust <name>` outside browser and jev; and no `plugins trust subagent spawn` anywhere in plugins.rs.
- A unit test over trust_one with the existing fake-eidolon/recording seam the tests already use (read tests.rs first): the subagent arm's calls are exactly untrust subagent, then trust subagent <v> for each of SUBAGENT_VOUCHED in order, and never spawn.
- every_bundled_plugin_has_an_explicit_arm still passes.
- The lifecycle test (real eidolon, MINERVA_TEST_EIDOLON, temp HOME with every XDG_* dir under it, swarm off, no model call): if eidolon has a read-only way to show the vouches on record, assert subagent_spawn is not vouched and subagent_list is; if it has none, say so and do not invent one.
risk: Low. A failure mid-arm leaves verbs asking (safe). An existing install that had the bare trust gets the untrust and the per-verb vouches on its next unsettled pass (an install or update): say so in the README.
